name: BlooP and FlooP
summary: Toy languages from Hofstadter's Gödel, Escher, Bach: BlooP has only bounded loops and computes exactly the primitive recursive functions, FlooP adds unbounded MU-LOOPs and is Turing-complete.

level_notes.1: Defined in chapter XIII of GEB (book, not open); the book resource links to its Wikipedia article.
level_notes.0: Only small hobby interpreters exist; none canonical.
